Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Results and verificationMethods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Fixed SPD matrix of size 12, a nearly singular rank-one matrix of size 8, Hilbert matrix of size 5 and Wilkinson matrix of size 12. Factors and triangular corrections use binary32; residuals use binary64, with five updates. Editorial clarification Small fixed examples only; convergence of mixed-precision refinement is not guaranteed for arbitrary matrices. Adopted numerical method Original implementations of LU with partial pivoting, lower Cholesky factorization and triangular substitution.
